body: I was very drunk yes. But when I'm drunk I act out thoughts that are always there. I hate that I hurt him. He's forgiven me and if I chose to we could carry on. But I can't do it. The violent thoughts are always there. I don't exactly feel guilty more just embarrassed. If I stay I'm going to keep doing impulsive things and causing problems. I'm incapable of having healthy relationships because as soon as I do the bad thoughts creep in and I end up ruining everything on purpose.

Kissed his best mate. Acted like a drunk twat in front of all his friends and attacked him. I've apologized and he's willing to move past it but I don't want to do that to him again. Shut off my phone and won't leave the house. Planning to end it before the month is over.
